column1: # Hand labels for the 200 words drawn at random from the suppressed list (scripts/audit-sample.sh). One judgement per word, by the author:
#   topical    an obvious sensitive reason (sex, violence, drugs, slurs, religion, death, ...)
#   lookalike  no reason on its own, but spelled like a word that has one
# Disagree? Edit the label and rerun `nosuggest report`.
